entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To speak with an agent, please press one.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF88602.
Okay, I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloFit Aero Helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?
The color is wrong. It's not what I wanted. The box is still unopened, if that matters.
I understand. Getting the right gear is important. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 42 days ago.

And that's perfectly fine. For a standard item like this helmet, you're well within our 90-day return window. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied, as having the right equipment you feel good about is a big part of safety and enjoying your ride.
Whatever. So you'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. I've just approved the return for you. I'm sending the prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should receive it in the next 5 to 10 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any postal service location.
Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Can I help you with anything else today?
Alright. Well, thank you for your call. We appreciate your business at VeloFit. Have a good day.
